verdict.rationale: Daily is a real-time video/voice platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers configurable background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: server-side event webhooks, REST control of calls, and hosting for Pipecat agents that developers build. The one built-in trigger, auto-starting a cloud recording when a token holder joins, is a narrow adjacent setting rather than a general automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
